Signing in

This admin platform is gated by Cloudflare Access.

To access the dashboard or API, browse to app.aidatasignal.com or api.aidatasignal.com. Cloudflare will:

  1. Ask for your email address.
  2. Email a one-time PIN to guillaumelauzier@gmail.com (only this address is allowed).
  3. Set a 24-hour session cookie scoped to the aidatasignal.com domain.

To sign out: visit https://axalnetwork.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/logout or click Sign out in the top-right of any page.
